answer_1.quote: We perform experiments on neural machine translation (NMT), abstractive text summarization and unconditional natural language generation (NLG) tasks.
datasets: English-Vietnamese corpus from the IWSLT 2015 Evaluation Campaign
English-German corpus from the WMT16 Evaluate Campaign
answer_1.outputs: generated text sequences in translation, summarization, and unconditional generation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model performance using BLEU scores.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is further considered to measure the quality of generation.
answer_4.guideline: 100 generated sentences from each model are rated 1-5, with means and standard deviations reported.
